on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      tag:
        description: Release tag
        required: true
        type: string
      ref:
        description: Immutable source commit; must equal the peeled release tag commit
        required: true
        type: string
      routing-mode:
        description: Prepare the captured App/library source vector and stop before native consumption.
        required: false
        default: false
        type: boolean
      app-sha:
        description: Exact App commit from the shared routing-vector job.
        required: false
        default: ''
        type: string
      media-kit-sha:
        description: Exact media-kit commit from the shared routing-vector job.
        required: false
        default: ''
        type: string
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      tag:
        description: Release tag to build
        required: true
        type: string
      routing-mode:
        description: Direct dispatch cannot capture the shared routing source vector.
        required: false
        default: false
        type: boolean

jobs:
  build-mac-app:
    name: macOS workflow (ARM64 hosted)
    runs-on: macos-26
    permissions:
      contents: read
    env:
      PILIPLUSX_RELEASE_TAG: ${{ inputs.tag }}
      PILIPLUSX_SOURCE_SHA: ${{ inputs.ref }}
      PILIPLUSX_SKIP_POINTER_FILTER_PATCH: ${{ !inputs.routing-mode && '1' || '' }}
    steps:
      - name: Reject uncaptured routing dispatch before any production step
        shell: bash
        env:
          ROUTING_MODE: ${{ inputs.routing-mode }}
          APP_SHA: ${{ inputs.app-sha }}
          MEDIA_KIT_SHA: ${{ inputs.media-kit-sha }}
          APP_REF: ${{ inputs.ref }}
          HEAD_NAME: ${{ github.head_ref || github.ref_name }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if [[ "$ROUTING_MODE" == "true" ]]; then
            mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/rb/r"
            printf 'routing-mode=%s\napp=%s\nmedia-kit=%s\nref=%s\n' \
              "$ROUTING_MODE" "$APP_SHA" "$MEDIA_KIT_SHA" "$APP_REF" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/rb/r/dispatch-preflight.txt"
            [[ "$APP_SHA" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]] || { echo 'Routing macOS requires a captured 40-character App SHA.' >&2; exit 1; }
            [[ "$MEDIA_KIT_SHA" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]] || { echo 'Routing macOS requires a captured 40-character media-kit SHA.' >&2; exit 1; }
            [[ "$APP_REF" == "$APP_SHA" ]] || { echo 'Routing macOS ref must equal the captured App SHA.' >&2; exit 1; }
          else
            [[ -z "$MEDIA_KIT_SHA" ]] || { echo 'A media-kit SHA requires routing mode.' >&2; exit 1; }
            [[ "$HEAD_NAME" != 'routing/MK-ROUTING-20261011' ]] || { echo 'Direct routing-branch builds are refused; invoke build.yml with its captured source vector.' >&2; exit 1; }
          fi

      - name: Prepare routing receipts directory
        if: ${{ inputs.routing-mode }}
        shell: bash
        env:
          APP_SHA: ${{ inputs.app-sha }}
          MEDIA_KIT_SHA: ${{ inputs.media-kit-sha }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          git config --global core.autocrlf false
          git config --global core.eol lf
          mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/rb/r"
          printf 'ROUTING_RESULTS=%s\nEXPECTED_APP_SHA=%s\nEXPECTED_MEDIA_KIT_SHA=%s\n' \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/rb/r" "$APP_SHA" "$MEDIA_KIT_SHA" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

      - name: Checkout exact routing App source
        if: ${{ inputs.routing-mode }}
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          repository: Goodwu/PiliPlusX
          ref: ${{ inputs.app-sha }}
          path: app
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Checkout exact routing media-kit source
        if: ${{ inputs.routing-mode }}
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          repository: Goodwu/media-kit
          ref: ${{ inputs.media-kit-sha }}
          path: media-kit
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Verify routing App base
        if: ${{ inputs.routing-mode }}
        working-directory: app
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED_APP_SHA"
          test "$(git -C ../media-kit rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED_MEDIA_KIT_SHA"
          git fetch --no-tags origin fix/darwin-video-output-rebuild-barrier
          git merge-base --is-ancestor FETCH_HEAD HEAD
          printf 'app=%s\nmedia-kit=%s\n' "$EXPECTED_APP_SHA" "$EXPECTED_MEDIA_KIT_SHA" | tee "$ROUTING_RESULTS/source.txt"

      - name: Bootstrap private current macOS sources
        if: ${{ inputs.routing-mode }}
        id: prepare
        uses: ./app/.github/actions/routing-bootstrap
        with:
          app-root: app
          media-kit-root: media-kit
          app-sha: ${{ inputs.app-sha }}
          media-kit-sha: ${{ inputs.media-kit-sha }}
          platform: macos

      - name: Verify current media-kit source resolution before bundle
        if: ${{ inputs.routing-mode && steps.prepare.outcome == 'success' }}
        id: source_verify_before
        working-directory: app
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python3 scripts/verify_routing_sources.py --app-root . --media-kit-root ../media-kit --output "$ROUTING_RESULTS/routing-sources-before.json" 2>&1 | tee "$ROUTING_RESULTS/source-verify-before.log"

      - name: Build current routing macOS Flutter bundle
        if: ${{ inputs.routing-mode && steps.prepare.outcome == 'success' && steps.source_verify_before.outcome == 'success' }}
        id: routing_bundle
        working-directory: app
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          flutter build bundle --debug --no-pub 2>&1 | tee "$ROUTING_RESULTS/bundle-build.log"

      - name: Verify current media-kit source resolution after bundle
        if: ${{ !cancelled() && inputs.routing-mode && steps.prepare.outcome == 'success' && steps.routing_bundle.outcome == 'success' }}
        id: source_verify_after
        working-directory: app
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python3 scripts/verify_routing_sources.py --app-root . --media-kit-root ../media-kit --output "$ROUTING_RESULTS/routing-sources-after.json" 2>&1 | tee "$ROUTING_RESULTS/source-verify-after.log"

      - name: Finalize current routing sources and freshness
        if: ${{ !cancelled() && inputs.routing-mode && steps.prepare.outcome == 'success' && steps.routing_bundle.outcome == 'success' && steps.source_verify_after.outcome == 'success' }}
        id: finalize
        working-directory: app
        shell: bash
        env:
          PRIVATE_ROOT: ${{ steps.prepare.outputs.private-root }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python3 scripts/prepare_routing_ci.py --app-root . --media-kit-root ../media-kit --flutter-root "$FLUTTER_ROOT" --private-root "$PRIVATE_ROOT" --output "$ROUTING_RESULTS" --expected-app-sha "$EXPECTED_APP_SHA" --expected-media-kit-sha "$EXPECTED_MEDIA_KIT_SHA" --platform macos --finalize 2>&1 | tee "$ROUTING_RESULTS/source-finalize.log"

      - name: Fail closed because no current macOS native producer input is available
        if: ${{ inputs.routing-mode && steps.routing_bundle.outcome == 'success' && steps.source_verify_after.outcome == 'success' && steps.finalize.outcome == 'success' }}
        id: native_block
        shell: bash
        env:
          APP_SHA: ${{ inputs.app-sha }}
          MEDIA_KIT_SHA: ${{ inputs.media-kit-sha }}
          ROUTING_RESULTS: ${{ runner.temp }}/rb/r
          NATIVE_ROOT: ${{ runner.temp }}/routing-native-macos
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python3 - "$ROUTING_RESULTS/macos-native-blocked.json" <<'PY'
          import json
          import os
          import sys
          from pathlib import Path

          diagnostic = {
              'taskId': 'MK-ROUTING-20261011',
              'stage': 'SOURCE_PREPARED_NATIVE_BLOCKED',
              'status': 'mac-current-native-input-unavailable',
              'platform': 'macos',
              'appCommit': os.environ['APP_SHA'],
              'mediaKitCommit': os.environ['MEDIA_KIT_SHA'],
              'bootstrapReceipt': str(Path(os.environ['ROUTING_RESULTS']) / 'bootstrap.json'),
              'bootstrapStatus': 'fresh-source-only',
              'currentConsumer': 'macOS shared output consumer requires a current accepted native producer receipt',
              'currentProducerReceipt': None,
              'currentProducerReceiptStatus': 'not-provided-to-this-workflow',
              'nativeInputRoot': os.environ['NATIVE_ROOT'],
              'nativeInputRootExists': Path(os.environ['NATIVE_ROOT']).exists(),
              'nativeBinaryProvenanceVerified': False,
              'nativeBuildStarted': False,
              'deviceTest': False,
          }
          Path(sys.argv[1]).write_text(json.dumps(diagnostic, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
          print('SOURCE_PREPARED_NATIVE_BLOCKED: current macOS native producer receipt and accepted local input are unavailable.', file=sys.stderr)
          raise SystemExit(1)
          PY

      - name: Upload routing macOS source and native availability diagnostics
        if: ${{ always() && inputs.routing-mode }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: routing-macos-source-native-diagnostics-${{ inputs.app-sha }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/rb/r
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 14

      - name: Checkout exact release source
        if: ${{ !inputs.routing-mode }}
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          ref: ${{ inputs.ref || inputs.tag }}

      # This legacy gate remains limited to the nonrouting release path.
      - name: Validate source and approved shared inputs
        if: ${{ !inputs.routing-mode }}
        run: python3.11 scripts/run_macos_shared_release.py --preflight

      - name: Setup Flutter
        if: ${{ !inputs.routing-mode }}
        uses: subosito/flutter-action@v2
        with:
          channel: stable
          flutter-version-file: pubspec.yaml

      - name: Build and verify shared release distribution
        if: ${{ !inputs.routing-mode }}
        run: python3.11 scripts/run_macos_shared_release.py

      - name: Generate and verify release metadata
        if: ${{ !inputs.routing-mode && success() }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          distribution_dir="$(find "$RUNNER_TEMP/piliplusx-shared-candidate" -mindepth 2 -maxdepth 2 -type d -name distribution -print -quit)"
          test -n "$distribution_dir"
          source_sha="${PILIPLUSX_SOURCE_SHA:-$(git rev-parse HEAD)}"
          mkdir -p release-metadata/macos
          cp "$distribution_dir"/* release-metadata/macos/
          media_kit_commit="$(python3.11 -c 'import json,sys; print(json.load(open(sys.argv[1], encoding="utf-8"))["approved_media_kit_revision"])' release-metadata/macos/*.shared-distribution.json)"
          python3.11 scripts/release_manifest.py release-metadata/macos \
            --platform macos --abi universal-arm64+x86_64 \
            --git-commit "$source_sha" \
            --media-kit-commit "$media_kit_commit" \
            --hdr-backend shared-gpu-next \
            --native-library-version mpv@0.41.0+shared-gpu-next
          python3.11 scripts/verify_release_manifest.py release-metadata/macos \
            --expected-source "$source_sha" \
            --source-checkout "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE"
          dmg_path="$(find "$distribution_dir" -maxdepth 1 -type f -name '*.dmg' -print -quit)"
          prefix="${dmg_path%.dmg}"
          cp release-metadata/macos/manifest.json "$prefix.manifest.json"
          cp release-metadata/macos/SHA256SUMS "$prefix.SHA256SUMS"

      - name: Upload successful shared release payloads
        if: ${{ !inputs.routing-mode && success() }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          if-no-files-found: error
          name: release-macos-arm64
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/piliplusx-shared-candidate/*/distribution/*

      - name: Upload failure diagnostics
        if: ${{ !inputs.routing-mode && failure() }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          if-no-files-found: ignore
          name: macos-shared-release-failure-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/piliplusx-shared-candidate-diagnostics/result.json
'
